title: Orange camera config image_levels block (version 2)
description: Camera config JSON (orange.camera.config v4) key image_levels: the brightness and saturation this camera should show in this configuration folder, checked at stream start (orange.recording.image_levels_check v2). Version 2 adds region: dish_interior checks the pixels inside the camera's active rim observation (orange.image_levels_dish_interior.v1), whole_frame every pixel (orange.image_levels.v1). Version 1 blocks still load and check the whole frame; the GUI writes version 2. At least one of expected_mean (with mean_tolerance_fraction) and max_saturated_fraction. basis records where the numbers came from: the GUI writes source gui_measurement, measured_at_utc, camera_frame_id, settings, statistics (whole frame) and, when the dish region was available, dish_interior {region, statistics}. Unknown fields are refused at load. Parsed and written by src/image_levels.cpp.

region.description: The pixels the limits apply to.
